section_flow.notes: Rounded-full link pills with a gradient Order-Now CTA pill on the right; liquid-glass mobile drawer with translucent backdrop blur.

Soft radial-gradient background with two blurry blob shapes pulsing slowly; left side has pill chip + Fraunces 2-line headline + dual button row + rating chip; right is photo card rotated -3deg with floating Est. 1998 badge.
Three rounded-4xl cards on alt-cream background with emoji icons, Fraunces titles, and one-line descriptions.
Square 1:1 photo with rounded-4xl mask, paired with chip + Fraunces headline and multi-paragraph story copy.
All / Bread / Cakes / Pastries chip filters drive a CSS columns masonry; each tile is rounded-3xl with photo + name + category chip.
Left: liquid-glass info card with address/phone/email/hours blocks. Right: surface card with name/email/message form and gradient submit button.
Brand + Visit Us + Contact columns above a thin border + © line.

hero_signature: Warm cream FDF6EC background overlaid with three radial-gradient ellipses in primary/accent tones, plus two pulsing blurred blob shapes. The right side photo card is tilted -3deg with a floating white Est. 1998 badge anchored to its bottom-left corner. The headline uses Fraunces serif in 2 lines — black line + primary-soft colored line — with a small uppercase pill above.
notable_features: Tilted hero photo card with floating est-year badge breaking the frame
Decorative blurred blob shapes with custom blob-bounce keyframe
Soft SVG noise grain overlay (4% opacity, multiply blend) site-wide
Filterable masonry gallery using CSS columns + break-inside-avoid
Liquid-glass info cards with backdrop-blur(16px) saturate(1.8)
Pill-style nav links with rounded-full pseudo-buttons
Gradient pill CTAs (135deg primary -> primary-soft) with scale hover
Emoji-led feature cards (intentionally analog-feeling, not icon)
motion_vocabulary: GSAP hero entrance timeline with back.out(1.7) easing on the image
Scroll-triggered feature card stagger with 100ms delays
Gallery filter uses GSAP fade+scale transitions on each tile
Mobile menu burger animates the three bars into an X via rotate + opacity
blob-bounce keyframe translates blobs -12px and scales 1.02 over 4s loop
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .liquid-glass (white 65% + blur 16px + saturate 1.8 + soft border), .btn-primary (gradient + scale-on-hover + colored drop-shadow), .btn-secondary (inset border ring), grain-overlay::after using fractalNoise data-URI at 0.04 opacity with multiply blend, CSS custom properties for all 11 color tokens, blob-bounce keyframe.
